title: Tempe Oasis | 5BR Pool | Near ASU & Mill Ave
description:
🌴 Your Tempe Home Base 🌴 

Enjoy a spacious 5-bedroom, 3-bath home with a private pool, huge backyard, and room for 12. Just minutes from ASU, Mill Ave, Old Town Scottsdale & Phoenix Sky Harbor. 

Perfect for families, group trips, ASU events, spring training, golf, tournaments—or simply relaxing together in the Arizona sunshine!

Traveling with a large group? We also own a 4-bedroom home directly across the alley, so larger groups can stay together in separate homes. Inquire for details.

 The space 
🏝️ THE BACKYARD

The backyard is the heart of the house.

Enjoy your private remodeled pool with a Baja shelf, perfect for lounging and soaking up the Arizona sun. There's plenty of space to spread out, relax, eat outside, or let the kids burn off some energy.

Please note: the pool is not heated.

We've also added a basketball hoop, cornhole, footballs and other games because we wanted this to feel like a place where families and friends actually spend time together — not just somewhere to sleep.

🛏️ 5 BEDROOMS • 3 BATHROOMS • SLEEPS 12

The home has 5 bedrooms and 7 beds, including two primary bedrooms, giving larger groups plenty of room to spread out.

Sleeping arrangements include:

• Primary Bedroom #1 — King + sofa bed
• Primary Bedroom #2 — King + crib
• Bedroom #3 — Queen
• Bedroom #4 — Queen
• Bedroom #5 — Bunk bed + floor mattress

There's also a crib, high chair, Pack 'n Play and other baby-friendly items available for families traveling with little ones.

📍 ONE OF TEMPE'S BEST LOCATIONS

You're close to everything:

• 5-minute Uber to Mill Avenue & ASU
• 9-minute Uber from Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport
• 13-minute Uber to Old Town Scottsdale
• 25 minutes to Glendale
• Approximately 5-minute walk to Palmer Park
• Local breweries, groceries and other conveniences within walking distance

The neighborhood itself is quiet, giving you a relaxing place to come home to after a day or night out.

🏀 MADE FOR GROUPS

The house was designed around gathering with family and friends. The open-concept living space makes it easy for everyone to hang out together, while the five bedrooms give everyone their own space when they want it.

That's what we love most about this house — it feels like a home rather than a hotel.

👶 TRAVELING WITH KIDS?

We've got you covered. In addition to the crib, we provide a high chair, Pack 'n Play and other baby essentials to make traveling with little ones easier.

✈️ WHY GUESTS LOVE IT

Our guests consistently mention three things: the pool, the location, and how much space the home provides for groups and families.

We're proud to have earned 4.98 stars across more than 120 reviews, including 5.0 ratings for accuracy, check-in and communication.

Come enjoy your own little piece of Tempe!
